description: Angular component for device profile autocomplete with features like fetching profiles, editing, adding, and linking to profile pages.

classes.name: DeviceProfileAutocompleteComponent
classes.description: Angular component providing device profile autocomplete functionality with profile fetching, editing, adding, and linking features.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers a callback for touch events (not implemented).

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up profile filtering observable.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles input property changes, resets profile on transportType change.

methods.name: selectDefaultDeviceProfileIfNeeded
methods.description: Selects default profile if configured and none selected.

methods.name: selectFirstDeviceProfileIfNeeded
methods.description: Selects the first profile from the list if configured.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form control.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Writes a profile ID value to the component, fetches profile info.

methods.name: onFocus
methods.description: Handles focus event, updates validity if dirty.

methods.name: onPanelClosed
methods.description: Handles autocomplete panel close, resets to 'all' profile if applicable.

methods.name: updateView
methods.description: Updates internal model and emits change events.

methods.name: displayDeviceProfileFn
methods.description: Returns display name for a profile.

methods.name: deviceProfileEnter
methods.description: Handles Enter key press to create new profile if enabled.

methods.name: createDeviceProfile
methods.description: Creates a new device profile via dialog.

methods.name: editDeviceProfile
methods.description: Opens dialog to edit current profile.

methods.name: openDeviceProfileDialog
methods.description: Opens dialog for adding or editing a device profile, updates model on save.
